resources.name: Omron Management
resources.description: Backend API for the Omron weight control system. See backend/AGENTS.md for the architecture and docs/schema.dbml for the data model.

resources.name: Skinfold Measurements
resources.description: CRUD for the SkinfoldMeasurement resource. This is a parent-child resource: each measurement has multiple details (one per site). All endpoints require auth:sanctum (Bearer token). Set the `token` env var to a Sanctum-issued personal access token. Authz: viewAny is admin-only; view/update are self (owner of the measurement_session) or admin; delete is self or super-admin; create is any authenticated user (validated against the measurement_session ownership).

resources.name: List Skinfold Measurements
resources.description: GET /api/skinfold-measurements — paginated list with filters. Query params (all optional): per_page (int 1..100, default 25), page (int >=1, default 1), measurement_session_id (int, exact match), skinfold_protocol_id (int, exact match). Results are ordered by created_at DESC. Filters AND together. Requires viewAny policy (admin/super-admin only).

resources.name: Create Skinfold Measurement
resources.description: POST /api/skinfold-measurements — body fields: measurement_session_id (int, required, must exist), skinfold_protocol_id (int, required, must exist), estimated_body_fat_percentage (float, optional, nullable, 0..99.9), details (array, required, min 1 element). Each detail must have: skinfold_site_id (int, required, must exist), value_mm (float, required, 0..999.9). Returns 422 on validation failure. The measurement_session must belong to the authenticated user (or user must be admin).

resources.name: Show Skinfold Measurement
resources.description: GET /api/skinfold-measurements/{skinfold_measurement} — returns the measurement with eager-loaded details (including site info) and protocol. Path: set `skinfold_measurement_id` env var or replace `{skinfold_measurement_id}` in the URL. Soft-deleted measurements return 404. Requires view policy (self or admin).

resources.name: Update Skinfold Measurement
resources.description: PUT/PATCH /api/skinfold-measurements/{skinfold_measurement} — all body fields optional (sometimes). estimated_body_fat_percentage (float, nullable, 0..99.9), details (array, if provided replaces all existing details). Each detail must have: skinfold_site_id (int, required, must exist), value_mm (float, required, 0..999.9). Soft-deleted measurements return 404. Requires update policy (self or admin).

resources.name: Delete Skinfold Measurement
resources.description: DELETE /api/skinfold-measurements/{skinfold_measurement} — soft delete (sets deleted_at). The measurement and its details stay in the DB but are hidden by the SoftDeletes global scope. Requires delete policy (self or super-admin).
